_comment: Site-wide flags. zhPublished is a PER-PAGE map (keyed by i18nKey) gating each Simplified-Chinese /zh/ page independently. For a page whose flag is false (DRAFT): its /zh/ page is noindex, no hreflang is emitted on either side of the pair, the /zh/ url stays out of sitemap.xml, and no language toggle renders. For a page whose flag is true (PUBLISHED): its /zh/ page drops noindex, the EN+/zh/ pair carries reciprocal hreflang (en/zh-Hans/x-default), the /zh/ url is listed in sitemap.xml with per-pair xhtml:link alternates, and the navbar language toggle renders. index + competition were published in Phase 1d; workshop + contact were published in Phase 2c (their drafts shipped in Phase 2b); register shipped published in both locales; the FAQ page was added and published since; the Hamburg Open Day page shipped published in both locales, followed by the Open Day hub and the Shanghai Open Day page, then the Munich Open Day page — all ten /zh/ pages are now live. Flip a flag back to false to return that page to a draft. Consumed by src/_data/eleventyComputed.js (zhNoindex/hreflangAlternates/localeToggle) and src/sitemap.njk.
_commentOpenDayRegistration: State of the Hamburg Open Day registration form on src/open-day-hamburg.njk (EN + /zh/). 'open' renders the live RSVP form; 'waitlist' renders the same form with a waitlist banner and the hidden list=waitlist field, for use once the 80 seats are gone; 'closed' renders a closed panel with no form. There is NO advance DATE cutoff: registration stays open until the program begins (17 Aug 10:30 CEST), so 'closed' is for use only from that moment on. Capacity is a SEPARATE axis from the calendar — a full house is what 'waitlist' is for, and never a reason to flip 'closed' early. An earlier 72-hour date cutoff (10:30 CEST on 14 Aug 2026) was advertised on the page and then dropped as wrong — do not reinstate it from old copy. Web3Forms cannot count submissions, so this is a MANUAL flip: change the value, rebuild, re-baseline open-day-hamburg.html, merge. 'closed' moves more than the form: it also drops the hero Register button, the travel card's 'register before you travel' clause, the inlined RSVP handler and the external web3forms client script, and flips the Event offers.availability to SoldOut. The hero and travel-card gates live INSIDE the page body's {% raw %} block, so each one closes raw and reopens it — a plain {% if %} there is emitted literally into the HTML and the build still succeeds. verify-zh's RSVP-redirect check is state-aware for this reason: it pins the zh redirect only when a redirect field is present, and otherwise asserts the form is genuinely absent. At 'closed' the open-day-success.html pair becomes unreachable — keep both; they are the redirect targets for when registration reopens. Consumed by src/open-day-hamburg.njk and src/zh/open-day-hamburg.njk. This flag is HAMBURG-ONLY: the Shanghai Open Day is invitation-only, has no registration form and no Offer node in its JSON-LD, so src/open-day-shanghai.njk (EN + /zh/) does not consume it — do not generalize this key to the other Open Days.
_commentOpenDayMunichRegistration: State of the Munich Open Day registration form on src/open-day-munich.njk (EN + /zh/). Same three states as the Hamburg key and read the same way: 'open' renders the live registration form; 'waitlist' renders the same form with a waitlist banner and the hidden list=waitlist field; 'closed' renders a closed panel with no form, drops the hero Register button, the inlined handler and the external web3forms client script, and flips the Event offers.availability to SoldOut. This flag is MUNICH-ONLY and must NOT be generalized: Hamburg has its own openDayRegistration and the two days run on independent flags, which is the whole point — Hamburg sat at 'closed' from 17 Aug while Munich opened, and a single shared key could not express that. Shanghai is invitation-only and reads neither. What 'waitlist' means here is NARROWER than at Hamburg: it signals that the 60 SHUTTLE seats are gone, NOT that the day is full. The talk room at Agile Robots SE has no stated capacity, so registration for the talks and the dinner stays open behind the banner — do not re-read 'waitlist' as a sold-out day. There is NO advance DATE cutoff: registration stays open until the program begins (10 Sep 10:00 CEST), so 'closed' is for use only from that moment on; a full shuttle is what 'waitlist' is for and is never a reason to flip 'closed' early. Web3Forms cannot count submissions, so this is a MANUAL flip: change the value, rebuild, re-baseline open-day-munich.html, merge. The hero gate lives INSIDE the page body's {% raw %} block, so it closes raw and reopens it — a plain {% if %} there is emitted literally into the HTML and the build still succeeds. At 'closed' the open-day-munich-success.html pair becomes unreachable — keep both; they are the redirect targets for when registration reopens. Consumed by src/open-day-munich.njk and src/zh/open-day-munich.njk.
_commentGsc: Additive, order-independent list of Google Search Console HTML-tag verification tokens — one per verifying owner. Rendered as Google site-verification <meta> tags (by src/_includes/layouts/base.njk) on pages whose front matter sets siteVerification: true (currently index, competition, workshop). Add a token to register a new owner; never remove an existing one or you un-verify that owner.
